activity_summary: After the reckoning, Kemp brought a crushed gingerbread out of his hat. You said the font's day is the one your family can stand upon, though your mother holds by St George, and you gave nobody a number. Heminges asked whether celebrating twice obliges the company twice. Burbage ate a corner before anyone had agreed. You left the day unimportant, and the book stayed shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood on the font's day, gave no number, and accepted one cake.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Produced the gingerbread and did not produce a second.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked whether twice obliges the company twice, and left the book shut.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Ate a corner before anyone agreed, and kept the afternoon's faults unnamed.

facets.activity: Kept Kemp's gingerbread to one cake

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You have had chances enough for an age to become official.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The font's day is the one my family can stand upon, though my mother holds by St George.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Whether celebrating twice obliges the company twice is the question.
